messages.subject: Read methylation files
parts:
Hello all,

I'm new for methylKit. I finished installing methylkit. and now come to the part I need to read my .cov file from Bismark. I'm not sure how to get to the input files?

>library(methylKit)
>file <- system.file("extdata", "WB1_bis_L001...bismark.cov", package = "methylKit")

Thanks a lot.

Regards,
Hongmei

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Read methylation files
parts:
You should read the documentation and the vignette . I'm not sure about the bismark's .cov format. If it has a genomic location, read coverage and percent methylation or ratio of methylation values, you can read it with methylKit. 

There are also how-tos here (http://zvfak.blogspot.de/search/label/methylKit) showing how to read methylation data with generic formats such as BSMAP format or extended BED format from UCSC browser. 

Best,
Altuna
